header.title: GLM-5 attention config suggests optimization for Chinese Moore Threads accelerators, not NVIDIA

s01_bottom_line.text: GLM-5 uses H=64 query heads giving arithmetic intensity 120.8 FLOP/B, versus the H~=128 ridge point for H800 at 258.2 FLOP/B; SemiAnalysis suspects this targets Moore Threads MTT S4000 (~128 FLOP/B), corroborated by Moore Threads' GLM-5.3-Flash day-0 support. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩
The article infers GLM-5 may be designed for different (likely Chinese) hardware than DeepSeek's H800-tuned configuration. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩

If leading Chinese open-weight models are being tuned to domestic silicon's roofline, it points to growing demand substitution away from NVIDIA/H800-class hardware toward Chinese accelerators, though the article offers only a circumstantial, inferential link.

items.text: H800's practical arithmetic intensity is 258.2 FLOP/B (865 TFLOP/s practical peak, 3.35 TB/s bandwidth per DeepSeek), implying the MLA head count ridge point is H~=128.
GLM-5's MLA configuration (d=512, r=64, b=2, H=64) yields an arithmetic intensity of 120.8 FLOP/B.
DeepSeek V3.2 MLA configuration uses head dimension d=512, RoPE dimension r=64, and 2 bytes per parameter.
GLM-5 increases the QK NoPE dimension from 128 to 192, with ablations showing superiority under iso-FLOP and iso-parameter constraints.
The change raises the SDPA head dimension from 192 to 256, still a 33% FLOP reduction after the head-count reduction.
MHA mode has 42x higher memory cost; MQA mode has up to 3.4x higher FLOPs.
